zoe (new-hire): hey team :wave: day 4 onboarding question. I'm trying to embed a Grafana panel into Notion for the runbook. When I paste the iframe it just renders an empty box with an X. I can view the dashboard in Grafana when logged in. anyone run into Notion stripping embeds?
marta (observability): Notion often blocks third-party cookies and can strip login state. Two options we use: 1) generate a short-lived embed token (preferred) and append ?k=TOKEN to the panel URL, or 2) use the docs proxy that injects a token server-side. Notion sometimes still refuses if X-Frame-Options header is present.
sam (devex): steps: Dashboard -> Share -> Embed -> Generate token (or request one via internal portal). If Notion refuses it might be due to response headers. If you see X-Frame-Options: DENY, Notion will not show it. Ping infra to review headers or request the docs proxy.
ben (infra): we don't change headers globally for security. For documented runbooks we create a docs proxy at docs.redwood.company that injects an embed token and strips the header only for that proxied path. File an access request: "Docs - Grafana embed proxy" and include the Notion page URL and dashboard UID. We'll review.
zoe (new-hire): is there a quick local test to see if the header is the issue?
carla (eng): yes, run:
```bash
curl -I "https://grafana.redwood.company/d/UID/my-dashboard?orgId=1"
```
Look for X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy. If X-Frame-Options is DENY or SAMEORIGIN that's your problem.
zoe (new-hire): ran it and saw X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN. that explains it. thanks.
sam (devex): FYI to request an embed token directly: https://redwood.company/internal/access-requests -> choose 'Grafana - Embed token' and include dashboard UID, target URL, TTL. Tokens default to 7 days. If you need longer-lived for a docs page, request 'Grafana - Service account (embed)'.
zoe (new-hire): done, submitted Embed token request (ID #5120). also quick Sentry question: I accepted an invite but when I open a project I still get "You don't have access". I accepted via SSO so thought I'd be in.
marta (observability): Sentry invites give org membership but project access is via Teams. The invite alone doesn't always add you to the project team. Ask the project owner to add you or request 'sentry-project-read' via the same portal and include the project slug.
zoe (new-hire): ok filing that too. small thing: is there a single place explaining which access request to pick for common tasks (embed vs service account vs dashboard edit)? couldn't find a concise list in the handbook.
sam (devex): we have a short matrix but it's not in the public handbook yet. temp link: https://redwood.company/internal/obs-access-matrix. TL;DR: embed token = ephemeral dashboard embed; service account = long-lived programmatic access; dashboard edit = folder edit rights; Datadog monitor edit = change monitors; Datadog post-to-channel = Slack integration channel add; Sentry project read/write = project team membership.
devex-bot: Access request submitted by zoe (new-hire) for 'Grafana - Embed token'. Request ID #5120. Routing to infra/docs-approvers. ETA: 1 business day.
zoe (new-hire): awesome 44f thanks everyone! I'll follow up if the proxy/embeds need infra review or if Sentry still denies access after the team add.
